description: Find licensed cannabis stores and delivery services near a ZIP code, or near a city in a given state, nearest first, from the state's own license lists. Each result has its distance, how the distance was measured, and its TerraVault page. A result of kind "maker" is a New York microbusiness that sells only what it grows and makes itself. A license is not a promise a store is open or has an item.

state.description: Two-letter state code, needed with city.

name: licensed_near
title: Licensed stores near a place
